subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu --bind grammar should become the canonical user-facing fix while preserving existing account binding behavior?
rationale: The branch changes a documented CLI/config-writing contract, and the repository has multiple open candidate fixes with different syntax choices; automation should not choose the permanent grammar or compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer routing
options.body: Keep <channel>:<account> behavior intact and introduce a documented explicit peer syntax or channel-owned conversation-id detection with tests for both account and peer binds.

options.title: Accept the Feishu-specific reinterpretation
options.body: Let feishu:<value> mean group peer by default and own the upgrade/documentation burden for existing Feishu account-scoped binds.

options.title: Adopt another candidate PR
options.body: Pause this branch and use a sibling candidate if its grammar and proof better preserve account semantics with less unrelated scope.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer routing
recommendation.body: Keep <channel>:<account> behavior intact and introduce a documented explicit peer syntax or channel-owned conversation-id detection with tests for both account and peer binds.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras introduced the account-scoped agents bind command surface that this compatibility decision would change.
